description: This file implements a mock certificate verifier class for testing purposes within the Chromium project's net module. It defines classes and methods to simulate certificate verification behavior, including rules for matching certificates and hostnames, handling asynchronous requests, and notifying observers.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier::Rule
classes.description: Represents a verification rule associating a certificate, hostname pattern, verification result, and return value.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier::MockRequest
classes.description: Represents a mock request for certificate verification, handling asynchronous result returning and cleanup.

classes.name: CertVerifierObserverCounter
classes.description: Counts the number of times the CertVerifier's change notification is triggered.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, either synchronously or asynchronously based on configuration.

methods.name: AddResultForCert
methods.description: Adds a verification result for a specific certificate.

methods.name: AddResultForCertAndHost
methods.description: Adds a verification result for a specific certificate and hostname pattern.

methods.name: SimulateOnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Simulates a change notification for the certificate verifier.

methods.name: VerifyImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation of the verification logic, matching rules against request parameters.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when the certificate verifier's state changes, incrementing the change count.
